scientific_integrity: Universal theorem is supported by the explicit generating-function, orthogonality and trigonometric-sum proof; exact finite computation is corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only odd positive initial terms and positive coprime steps; independent validation not performed; an earlier implicit equivalent from general Fourier-Dedekind formulas is a residual originality risk.
title: Exact mean-square periodic error for arithmetic-progression denumerants
